Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the specific asks we agreed would help us get a clean procurement path in place:

• Marketplace: Northbridge is open to trying Redwood via the Cloud Marketplace for ease of procurement, but Legal wants to confirm data residency & audit logs before marketplace listing.
• Budget owner & approvals: Sophie noted the economic buyer is Alyssa Chen (VP Clinical Ops), finance sponsor is Marcus Liu (Director of Finance), and the signatory is likely Rita Patel (CFO) for deals >$75k. Please confirm titles.
• Timing: tentative go/no-go decision targeted for mid-May.

Attachments: procurement-questionnaire.pdf (short form we discussed) — please fill the highlighted procurement/contact fields so our contracts team can draft PO-friendly terms.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sophie/Mark: confirm the budget owner + finance sponsor and whether procurement requires specific PO language or supporting SLAs.
2) Redwood: we'll circulate a one-page MAP (mutual action plan) and a draft pricing quote geared for PO terms and marketplace option.
3) Schedule 30m procurement kickoff with Alyssa + Marcus + Rita if possible the week of May 3.

If helpful, Ben and I can join the kickoff to walk the legal/finance folks through the contract flow and card vs PO scenarios.
